# Harvest report, September

> [!summary] The short version
> The plot gave **41 kg** this month, the best September in three years. Squash carried it. Carrots were poor: the fly got under the cover.

## The numbers

![[harvest-chart.html]]

The chart is a standalone page with a script. The frame needs the network. The link under it opens the page full screen, and that works offline.

| Crop | Kilograms | Against last year |
|---|---|---|
| Squash | 22 | Up 6 |
| Broad beans | 9 | Level |
| Salad leaves | 6 | Up 1 |
| Carrots | 4 | Down 5 |

## Why the squash did well

Bed 3 was limed after the soil test. The test is a note of its own, embedded here:
